note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. volunteer_force: conscript intakes ended in the mid-1990s and compulsory attendance has been suspended since 1 May 1997. social_insurance: until 2006 the Netherlands had separate public sickness-fund and private health insurance systems, replaced in January 2006 by mandatory private insurance with risk equalisation. pluralist_secularism: no state church, with publicly funded religious schools. free_trade reflects EU single-market membership. energy_mix and open_internet are judgement calls for 2000.
